exposure: Patients who underwent lumbar decompression procedures
Patients who underwent posterior cervical foraminotomies (PCF)
cohort: 229 consecutive patients who underwent MESS for degenerative spinal disorders.
finding: MESS achieved high success rates for treating degenerative spinal disorders in the long term, with increased instrument angulation improving access to compressive pathology and lowering surgical time and repeated procedure rate, without affecting clinical outcome or complication rate.
